medicalReason.title: What do you need help with?
medicalReason.subtitle: Select the category that best describes your concern
medicalReason.descriptionPlaceholder: Please describe your symptoms, when they started, and any relevant details...
medicalReason.emergencyText: Online consultations are not for emergencies. For chest pain, difficulty breathing, severe bleeding, signs of stroke, thoughts of self-harm or another emergency, seek emergency care now. In the UAE call 998 for an ambulance; outside the UAE call your local emergency number.
medicalReason.ackEmergency: I confirm this is not an emergency and I understand the doctor may refer me to in-person or emergency care.
medicalReason.ackTelehealth: I consent to a remote video consultation and understand its limitations (no physical examination; narcotic and controlled medicines cannot be prescribed online).
medicalReason.ackPrivacy: I consent to DocNow processing and storing my personal and health information to provide this consultation, and to it being recorded in my medical record.
medicalReason.consentRequired: Please confirm all three statements to continue.
medicalReason.invalidDescription: Enter a description of up to 2,000 characters.
